summary: iomart's DC1 is a purpose-adapted colocation and managed hosting data centre just south-west of Glasgow city centre (Kinning Park area), publicly advertised at 88 Middlesex Street. Directory listings state roughly 1 MW of power across two data halls of about 4,000 sq ft each. iomart Group plc is a Glasgow-headquartered, AIM-listed cloud and hosting company.
maturity_explanation: Actively marketed operating facility on iomart's own website and third-party directories as of July 2026.
